name: shell
description: Raw shell execution and durable background jobs, installed independently of the Praxis host

tools.name: execute_terminal
tools.description: Run shell command. Long-running commands: use run_background instead, then poll with background_status (finished jobs also announce themselves).

tools.name: run_background
tools.description: Start a long-running shell command DETACHED (compile, download, server). Returns a job id immediately so you can keep working. The job announces its completion to the user's dashboard automatically; poll background_status only if you need the result mid-task.

tools.name: background_status
tools.description: Check status/output of a detached background command. Call without job_id to list all jobs.
